title: Director of Affiliate Marketing at Macy’s Sees Influencer Affiliates as an Upper-Funnel Channel Whose Value Extends Beyond Attributed Sales
expert: Director of Affiliate Marketing at a retailer (Macy's per title); industry estimates only, no Meta first-hand data; interview 2026-08-07
